question: Does lineage-wide phylogenetic-memory context vary systematically with family crown age or backbone family richness?
context_score: BLUP family random intercept from rho ~ 0 + trait_name + (1|family), separately by source and tree axis
family_age: GBOTB.extended.TPL tree height minus depth of full-backbone family crown MRCA
family_richness: number of GBOTB backbone tips assigned to family

interpretation.replicated_age_direction: same-sign age association with p<=0.05 in both compilations on S3, supported by prune direction
interpretation.not_replicated: do not use age/richness as explanation of lineage context
